faces.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING
"No news on Sabik, but the Reds'll keep us plenty busy. They're buildin' something in Europe; their chatter is callin' it a ‘control center.’ We want to know what it's for, so figure out where it's bein' built and send a team to bug it.
There's another MEDUSA trial as well; try to help as many cities as you can."
OPEN
0007
and read its contents.
